definitions.explanation: Describes a face or complexion that looks unhealthily pale, often due to illness, shock, or fear.
Describes a faint, cold, bluish-white light or color.

examples.japanese: ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{青白|あおじろ}い。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{青白|あおじろ}い⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{立|た}っていた→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: He was standing there with a pale face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{顔色|かおいろ}→顔色：25468_kaoiro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{青白|あおじろ}かった。
examples.english: Perhaps he had a fever — his complexion was pale since morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{青白|あおじろ}く⟦{光|ひか}っていた→光る：01163_hikaru⟧。
examples.english: The moon shone with a pale bluish light.

examples.japanese: ⟦{蛍光灯|けいこうとう}→蛍光灯：09624_keikoutou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{青白|あおじろ}い⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{照|て}らしていた→照らす：04669_terasu⟧。
examples.english: The bluish-white light of the fluorescent lamp illuminated the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜明|よあ}け→夜明け：03655_yoake⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{青白|あおじろ}く⟦{染|そ}まり→染まる：04254_somaru⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The sky before dawn began to take on a pale bluish tinge.

notes:
An i-adjective. Compound of ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧ (blue) + ⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧ (white).

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {青白|あおじろ}く
- Noun form: {青白|あおじろ}さ

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{青白|あおじろ}い (face is pale)
- {青白|あおじろ}い⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧ (pale/bluish-white light)
- {青白|あおじろ}い⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ (pale skin)

When describing a person's complexion, {青白|あおじろ}い implies ill health or shock. It is not used as a compliment for fair skin — {色白|いろじろ} is used instead.
